title: Fall Commencement
seo_title: Fall Commencement at Missouri State University, Dec 11
description: Missouri State University holds its fall commencement ceremonies for graduates at Great Southern Bank Arena, with a 10 am ceremony for the Darr College of Agriculture, College of Business, College of Natural and Applied Sciences, and Interdisciplinary Academic Programs, and a 1:30 pm ceremony for the McQueary College of Health and Human Services, Reynolds College of Arts, Social Sciences, and Humanities, and College of Education. No ticket is required, doors open 90 minutes before each ceremony, and only clear bags are permitted. It takes place Friday, December 11, 2026, at 901 S. National Ave. in Springfield, MO.
address: Missouri State University, 901 S. National Ave.
